columns.generation_expression:
CASE
    WHEN (harvested_area_ha > (0)::numeric) THEN round((production_kg / harvested_area_ha), 2)
    ELSE (0)::numeric
END

CASE
    WHEN (unit_price IS NULL) THEN NULL::numeric
    ELSE (liters * unit_price)
END

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX campaigns_company_name_ci_unique ON public.campaigns USING btree (company_id, lower(btrim(name)))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX campaigns_pkey ON public.campaigns USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX idx_campaigns_company_status_dates ON public.campaigns USING btree (company_id, status, start_date DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX companies_pkey ON public.companies USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX companies_subscription_status_idx ON public.companies USING btree (subscription_status)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX crop_assignments_pkey ON public.crop_assignments USING btree (id)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX crop_assignments_source_planning_sub_lot_unique ON public.crop_assignments USING btree (source_planning_id, sub_lot_id) WHERE ((source_planning_id IS NOT NULL) AND (sub_lot_id IS NOT NULL))

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX crop_assignments_source_planning_whole_lot_unique ON public.crop_assignments USING btree (source_planning_id, lot_id) WHERE ((source_planning_id IS NOT NULL) AND (sub_lot_id IS NULL))
CREATE INDEX idx_crop_assignments_company_campaign ON public.crop_assignments USING btree (company_id, campaign_id)
